description: Source code for the TbCopyAttributesToEntityViewNode class, a rule engine node in Thingsboard that copies attributes from assets/devices to entity views and modifies message originator.

classes.name: TbCopyAttributesToEntityViewNode
classes.description: A rule engine node that copies attributes from assets/devices to entity views and updates message originator.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with context and configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, processes attribute copying based on message type and entity view timing.

methods.name: getFutureCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback for attribute save/delete operations to proceed with message transformation.

methods.name: transformAndTellNext
methods.description: Enqueues the message for the next processing step with updated entity view ID.

methods.name: attributeContainsInEntityView
methods.description: Checks if a given attribute key is part of the entity view's attribute keys for the specified scope.
